provenance: Known-good VC runtime set (14.4x, pre-2026-11-21) taken from the shipped 9.2 bundle. The 2026-11-21 system VC redist update (installed alongside Plex) breaks PySide6 6.12 shiboken in frozen builds: Shiboken::BindingManager static mutex (mtx_do_lock) AVs at QtCore import. app.spec prefers these pinned copies over System32.
